body.prompt: Use the supplied full Failure page only as style guidance. Generate one new independent UI sprite, never crop a screenshot. Dark near-black navy lacquer, subdued antique gold, fine Russian fairy-tale metalwork with very restrained highlights; no vivid yellow overall wash. True transparent exterior alpha; fully opaque painted interior. No text, letters, numbers, icons, people, scenery or checkerboard. All edges visible with narrow transparent margin. One tall rectangular dark navy panel for a game outcome page. Fine thin antique gold perimeter, clipped corners and tiny corner studs only. NO scrolls, loops, side ornaments, handles, giant metal curls or jewels. Huge empty opaque subtly textured near-black navy interior. This is an understated outer panel supporting other controls, not a title.
